df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Now, print the exact numbers that will be in the evidence — these must be computed and printed by code

num_qa = len(completed_df[completed_df['revenue'] == qa_pattern])

# Print each number
print("Number of completed orders:", num_completed)
print("Number of QA orders (revenue = '999,999.99'):", num_qa)
